prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: SABLE CIRCUIT production enemy master, a single isolated non-humanoid tracked shield robot.
Primary request: Create a premium realistic 3D-rendered dark industrial sci-fi autonomous shield crawler for an isometric tactical action game, wholly different from a flying crescent drone. A low wide tracked chassis with exactly two continuous caterpillar tread housings, a massive sloped segmented blast shield built into the FRONT, compact protected amber optical slit and one short horizontal recessed cannon port centered through the front shield. Rear exposed cooling fins and power assembly. Gun and shield visibly face right (E), pure right side game view at fixed 30-degree elevated orthographic camera. No humanoid head, torso, arms, hands, legs, knees, feet or pilot. Scale approximately 1.5 metres long, low waist-height tank; broad chunky armored silhouette.
Style: sophisticated cinematic physically based game asset, worn charcoal and gunmetal, dark sand-yellow armor plates, sparse amber indicators, machined metal, restrained wear and rich readable material detail; consistent with dark SABLE CIRCUIT space-facility combat. No cartoon, no vector, no low-poly toy.
Composition: ONE complete robot centered, all tread/contact surfaces and cannon visible, generous transparent margins, 1536x1024 landscape or higher native resolution. Camera 30 degrees above horizontal; no perspective convergence, no environment.
background: transparent_alpha
Output: actual RGBA PNG. Background alpha exactly 0; subject visible alpha 1 through 254, solid interiors alpha 254, never 255. Preserve native transparency. No green/chroma, no white/black background, no checkerboard pixels, no shadow, no floor, no text, no labels, no watermark. No gunfire or effects, no cut-off parts. This is a NEW original robot, not an edit of or reuse of a previous character.
